h1: Inspect anywhere, with the expert looking over your shoulder.
lede: SmartInspect delivers AR inspection workflows with live remote expert collaboration. Built for global teams, it adds captioning and multilingual support so an inspector on site and a specialist on another continent work from the same view, with every step recorded.

blocks.eyebrow: SmartInspect on the Smart Solutions Platform
blocks.title: Collaboration · Remote Experts · Multilingual
blocks.body: Step-by-step inspection workflows in the inspector’s view, live sessions with remote experts who can annotate and guide, and multilingual captioning for global teams. Reports and evidence generated as the inspection happens.

captioning and translation for global teams

blocks.text: AR-powered solutions designed to improve efficiency across industries

SmartInspect is one of four solutions on the Smart Solutions Platform from Purview Technologies, the group’s AI and XR company. The platform puts AR smart glasses, real-time captioning and translation, and Purview’s vision and voice AI into the hands of frontline teams, so the people doing the work see what they need, hands free, and the people supporting them can be anywhere.

items.title: AR inspection workflows
items.body: Checklists and procedures step by step in view, with photo and video evidence captured at each point.

items.title: Remote expert collaboration
items.body: Specialists join live, see the inspector’s view, annotate and approve.

items.title: Captioning and multilingual support
items.body: Conversations captioned and translated so global teams work together.

items.title: Digital audit trail
items.body: Time-stamped evidence, sign-offs and reports generated automatically.

items.title: Integration
items.body: Results posted to asset, maintenance and quality systems.

items.title: Data centre and industrial use
items.body: Proven on Purview DC floors and extended to plants, sites and fleets.

items.q: Does it work in low-connectivity sites?
items.a: Workflows run on the device; sessions and uploads sync when connectivity allows. Details on request.

items.q: Is it used by Purview itself?
items.a: Yes. Purview DC uses SmartInspect on data centre installations and audits.

items.q: Which systems does it integrate with?
items.a: Asset, maintenance and quality platforms through APIs.
